environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached to ALB with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet priority 1 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' priority 2 containing a single RegexPatternSet rule matching request query strings against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|delete|insert|update)|'\s*or\s+'|'\s*--)|(?:%27|%2527)` with action BLOCK and CloudWatch metric 'SQLiBlockedRequests', (3) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet priority 3 in BLOCK mode. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to a Splunk index but this is observability only. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and the SQLite database is mounted from an EFS volume with uid/gid restrictions.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, TLS 1.2+ only
config.waf_rule_priority_2: Custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' - RegexPatternSet on QueryString - BLOCK mode - pattern covers UNION SELECT, stacked queries, OR-based tautologies, URL-encoded quotes
config.container: Read-only root filesystem, EFS mount at /var/lib/app with access point enforcing uid=1000 gid=1000
config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet, SG on ALB allows 0.0.0.0/0:443
